_note: Wall-clock seconds on an 8 GB Apple Silicon MacBook, single run, models already downloaded to the local Hugging Face cache. Embedding stages use the Metal (MPS) backend when available; the figures therefore exclude the one-off download, which is about 2 GB in total and dominates a cold first run. Gemini methods run through the batch API; end-to-end time depends on queueing and is reported qualitatively in the thesis.
